title: Cucumber Caprese Salad
description: Elevate your caprese salad with cucumber! Crisp slices of fresh cucumber add textural interest to everybody’s favorite Italian summer salad.
ingredients: 2 large Roma tomatoes, sliced into 1/4-inch-thick rounds
1 large cucumber, peeled and sliced into 1/4-inch-thick rounds
1 (8 ounce) package sliced fresh mozzarella cheese
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Bring balsamic vinegar to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat. Boil until reduced to 1/4 cup, about 8 minutes. Remove from the heat and allow to cool to room temperature.

While the balsamic vinegar is cooling, arrange tomatoes, cucumber, mozzarella slices, and basil leaves in a layered pattern on a small serving platter until the platter is covered. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Drizzle 1 to 2 tablespoons of the cooled balsamic vinegar over the salad. Serve immediately.
